parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Harness/PlayerControllerTestHarness.swift`. Despite a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.833), `postInterruptionBegan` and `postInterruptionEnded` are intentionally distinct test-harness helpers that simulate semantically opposite audio-session interruption lifecycle events. Merging or parameterizing them would couple unrelated test semantics and obscure the intent of each helper in test-failure diagnostics.
